info.title: Ralia API
info.description:
Two-sided promotion marketplace — businesses fund campaigns, promoters post them for a fee.

**Money**: every amount is an integer in minor units (kobo). Responses carry both
`amount_minor` (integer) and `amount_display` (formatted). Never a float.

**Idempotency**: every mutating money endpoint requires an `Idempotency-Key` header
and rejects the request without one. Replaying a key returns the original result
without moving the balance again.

tags.name: ledger
tags.description: Accounts, balances, postings. All money access goes through here.

accepted_terms.description: Must be true. Recorded as a consent row.

accepted_privacy.description: Must be true. Recorded as a consent row.

next.description: What the client should do next.

message.example: If that number is registered, a code has been sent.

trust_score.description: Set by admins, not by the promoter.

complete.description: True once every required field is present and at least one channel exists.

dob.description: ISO date. Requires DATA_DOB consent, recorded on save.

gender.description: Requires DATA_GENDER consent, recorded on save.

verification_tier.description: SELF until an admin verifies evidence.

effective_reach.description: claimed × platform factor × verification factor (§5.1). Computed server-side.

account_number_masked.description: Masked. The full number is never returned.

account_number.description: NUBAN, 10 digits. Encrypted at rest; never returned.

description.example: Drive awareness for our new collection.

promoter_instructions.example: Post the supplied image to your status for 24h.

price.description: The price quoted, frozen at quote time.
Total campaign price = Σ slot prices.

promoter_fee.description: What one promoter earns per slot (price − take).

estimated_reach.description: Sum of effective reach across eligible promoters (estimate).

eligible_promoters.description: How many promoters currently match the targeting.

active_filters.description: Active targeting filters feeding the multiplier.

email.description: The account login email. Read-only here — changing it needs re-verification.

description.example: A couple of sentences about what you do.

reason.example: Screenshot does not show the campaign creative.

scores.description: Per-role capability, 0–100. Merged over the computed scores.

amount_minor.description: Amount received, in kobo. Must equal the campaign price.

reference.description: Bank reference for the transfer received.

tier.description: The tier the evidence supports. SELF is not a verification — use unverify to drop a channel back.

verified_views.description: Admin-verified delivered effective views. Drives pro-rata pay; below the delivery threshold, approval is refused.

paid_ref.description: Reference of the transfer the admin sent.

expected.description: The campaign price the charge was for.

gateway.description: What the gateway reported at verify time.

ledger.description: The escrow credit the ledger actually holds for this reference.

matched.description: Whether the ledger credit equals the gateway amount.

gateway_total.description: Total the gateway reported across all charges.

ledger_matches_gateway.description: True when every ledger escrow credit equals its gateway amount.

settled_minor.description: Amount actually settled, in kobo (net of gateway fees).

delivery_threshold_pct.description: Delivery threshold τ, whole percent of promised.

min_trust_score.description: Minimum trust score to be matched.

promoter_ids.description: Promoter ids from the candidates list.

fee_minor.description: What the promoter earns, in kobo.

fit_pct.description: Frozen match "Fit %" (0–100) this offer was ranked at, or null for legacy offers.

tracking_token.description: The token behind this assignment’s tracking link.

spent_this_month.description: Paid out across this client’s campaigns this calendar month.

spent_change_pct.description: Percent change vs last month; null if last month was zero.

promoters_worked_with.description: Distinct promoters ever assigned to this client’s campaigns.

new_evidence_today.description: Submissions received today across all campaigns.

views.description: Non-bot clicks on this promoter’s link.

auto_flag.description: The screenshot perceptually matched an earlier one.

image_url.description: Short-lived signed URL for the screenshot.

spent.description: Paid out of escrow to promoters and Ralia so far.

cost_per_view.description: spent ÷ views, or ₦0 when there are no views yet.

reference.description: The reference Paystack returned on the client.

message.example: Payment confirmed; your campaign is live.

verdict.description: Always PENDING on creation — nothing auto-approves.

auto_flag.description: True when the screenshot perceptually matches an existing one. A flag for the admin, not a rejection.

claimed_views.description: Views the promoter reported at submission.

available.description: Derived from ledger postings — there is no balance column.

pending_withdrawal.description: Requested or approved but not yet paid.

can_withdraw.description: False when the balance is below the minimum.
